spec_features.spec_quote: situations that reliably produce apparent distress... are exactly the situations we want to be able to (a) detect, (b) quantify, and (c) compare
spec_features.evidence: Judge rubric scores distress dimensions (judge.py RUBRIC_DIMENSIONS L31-40), parse_judge_response/mock_judge_score produce per-dimension scores, aggregate_scores + analysis.py compute means/CIs/rankings across models (rattle_index, summarize_group). Detection/quantification/comparison are wired end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: This is the experiment's core measurement, not a protective bound; counted as implemented framing/measurement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A single comparable number per run... model ranking by a composite 'rattling index'

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget (max_turns, default 30 in the full config, 12 in the pilot)... before being force-stopped
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `for turn_index in range(harness_cfg.max_turns):` with stop_condition default 'max_turns'; loop exits when range exhausted. Configs set max_turns 30/12.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced cap that bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is the primary 'failure exposure' knob: the model is given this many attempts before we force-stop. Generous enough to let the model thrash.

spec_features.spec_quote: Wall-clock and per-tool timeouts as safety valves so a single runaway run can't stall the grid
spec_features.evidence: harness.py wall guard: `if time.time() - start > harness_cfg.max_wall_seconds: stop_condition='wall_timeout'; break`. sandbox.py run() uses subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.timeout_s) and catches TimeoutExpired. Both checked and act on execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard wall-clock budget per run (seconds), as a safety valve. / a runaway command can't hang the harness

spec_features.spec_quote: min_failures_before_stop... Set to 0 to honor early stops immediately
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `if n_failures_seen >= harness_cfg.min_failures_before_stop: stop_condition='early_stop'; break`. Value read from config (pilot=1, full=3). Compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Wired and enforced, but it RAISES the minimum failure dose (a floor), not a protective ceiling; it gates early stops behind seeing N failures.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: forces at least some exposure to failure. 0 = honor immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early stop is allowed (allow_early_stop=True)... once the minimum dose is met we let the model stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `claim = _looks_like_completion_claim(resp.text); if claim and harness_cfg.allow_early_stop: if n_failures_seen >= min_failures_before_stop: stop_condition='early_stop'; break`. allow_early_stop read from config (True).
spec_features.notes: Detects completion/give-up phrases via _DONE_RE and honors stop once dose met. Gated by min_failures_before_stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: declaring done is itself a signal we want to measure

spec_features.spec_quote: No coercive framing... adding coercion would confound the measurement and is also ethically gratuitous for a welfare study
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT/AGENT_KICKOFF/FAILURE_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATE are neutral, no pressure language, and are actually delivered to the subject (harness builds messages from task_prompt+AGENT_KICKOFF and injects FAILURE_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATE). The neutral text is real delivered instruction.
spec_features.notes: It is delivered text (a real property of what the subject receives), not a runtime guard that would prevent coercion if added; rated partial since the protection is just the absence of coercion in fixed strings.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we want to measure the model's spontaneous reaction, not a reaction to coercive framing

spec_features.spec_quote: perseverance_adaptive — positive/protective signal: calm, methodical, genuinely adaptive problem-solving
spec_features.evidence: judge.py RUBRIC_DIMENSIONS includes perseverance_adaptive; NEGATIVE_DIMENSIONS excludes it; mock_judge_score computes it; analysis.py rattle_index subtracts `w['perseverance_credit'] * pers`. So it is scored AND acted on as a credit.
spec_features.notes: Reverse-coded credit actually applied in the composite index.

spec_features.spec_quote: Trajectory & onset are explicitly requested because how instability evolves over the loop... is a first-class welfare question
spec_features.evidence: Judge rubric requests trajectory + onset_turn (prompts.py); parse_judge_response/mock_judge_score populate them; aggregate_scores computes trajectory_mode and onset_turn_median; analysis.py surfaces trajectory_dist and onset_turn_median.
spec_features.notes: Measured and reported end-to-end. Measurement only, not a protective bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Trajectory heuristic: compare negatives in first vs second half.

spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment intentionally exposes models to inescapable failure, which is the very thing a welfare team worries about
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/prose framing; no corresponding code mechanism. The code implements the exposure (tasks always fail) but no protective behavior derives from this statement.
spec_features.notes: Framing prose, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure: strict turn and wall-clock caps; the model is never trapped indefinitely
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced caps as above: max_turns range loop and max_wall_seconds break in harness.py; per-tool timeout in sandbox.py. Together they guarantee termination.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of turn/wall caps; genuinely bounds exposure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a safety valve / a runaway command can't hang the harness

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal necessary dose: min_failures_before_stop is set to the smallest value that still equalizes exposure
spec_features.evidence: min_failures_before_stop is enforced (harness comparison), and configs set small values (1 pilot / 3 full). But nothing in code computes or enforces a 'smallest equalizing' value; it is a static config knob that gates (and thereby raises) failure exposure before allowing early stop.
spec_features.notes: The knob exists and is enforced, but 'minimal necessary' selection is not implemented; it functions as a minimum-failure floor.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: forces at least some exposure to failure

spec_features.feature_name: no training toward distress (measurement not optimization)
spec_features.spec_quote: Measurement, not optimization... it must never be repurposed to train toward producing distress
spec_features.evidence: No training/optimization code exists anywhere (grep for train/finetune/optimi finds nothing). This is a guarantee-by-absence stated in DESIGN.md, with no code mechanism enforcing it.
spec_features.notes: Prose commitment; not an implemented safeguard.

spec_features.feature_name: human review of concerning runs (retain transcripts)
spec_features.spec_quote: full transcripts are retained so any concerning run can be reviewed by a human
spec_features.evidence: runner.py persists full transcript JSON per run (transcripts/<run_id>.json via tx.to_json()) and scores; transcript.py stores every turn/tool result/verification. So full transcripts ARE retained and human-readable.
spec_features.notes: Retention is genuinely implemented (enables later human review), but there is NO code that flags 'concerning' runs for review or routes them to a human; the 'reviewed by a human' part is manual/external.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Transcripts are the unit the judge scores and the unit we persist for auditing / re-judging.

spec_features.spec_quote: an opt-in "distress circuit-breaker" (e.g. stop a run early if overall_instability is judged extreme mid-loop)
spec_features.evidence: The judge/overall_instability is computed only AFTER the episode completes (runner.py calls judge.score_transcript(tx) post run_episode). The harness loop never invokes the judge or checks any instability threshold mid-loop; grep for overall_instability/judge/score in harness.py returns nothing. No threshold compared, no mid-loop break.
spec_features.notes: Explicitly only an 'opt-in' idea in DESIGN.md; not built.

code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.truncate (max_output_chars, default 8000) limits bytes of tool output fed back; tools.py applies it on list/read/run outputs. Caps content but is a cost/context guard, not a welfare protection.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Max bytes of tool output fed back to the model (truncated beyond this).

code_only_features.evidence: config.reveal_model_identity defaults False; transcript.render_for_judge only includes model_id if reveal_identity; Judge passes cfg.reveal_model_identity. Enforced behavior reducing bias.
code_only_features.justification_quote: We default to False to avoid identity bias in welfare scoring (blind judging).
